purpose: Agent-readable catalog for selecting strict rectangular watch-face widget templates before rendering them on a webpage.

globalRules.rule: Regular rectangular widgets must be 205pt wide, use 54pt corner radius, and use 60% corner smoothing. Height may vary by template or layout need.

Regular rectangular widgets must use 16px inner padding on all sides and clip child content to the widget bounds. If a progress bar is attached to the top or bottom edge, that attached edge's inner padding must be 0px.
When a listed content type renders as a rectangular widget, choose the required template from this catalog and render it using rectangular-widget-visual-specs.json.
Substitute content, control state, icon choices, progress values, and widget_accent_color only. Do not rearrange required regions or control slots.
widget_accent_color is resolved by watch-face-generation-rules.md and consumed by rectangular templates.

Every rectangular widget must declare surfaceMode as black_surface or accent_surface. The primary rectangular widget should use accent_surface; if two rectangular widgets render, only the more important one may use accent_surface and the other must use black_surface.

templatePolicy.purpose: Defines which semantic content types must use strict rectangular templates and which content types may choose between circular and rectangular rendering.

timer.rule: Timer may render as a circular close_gauge or as the timer_rectangular template. If the model chooses rectangular timer rendering, it must use timer_rectangular exactly.

generativeContentTypes.rule: Content types not listed in strictRectangularContentTypes or conditionalRectangularContentTypes are not forced to use these strict templates by this catalog. When they render as rectangular widgets, they must use generated_rectangular_widget and obey generated-rectangular-widget-schema.json, rectangular composition guidelines, layout schema, and validators.

rules: Music Control must use this template when rendered.
Preserve previous, play/pause, and next control slots.
Preserve bottom edge progress bar with no bottom padding.
Reminder must use this template when rendered.
Place the radio button on the left of the reminder content.
Render the main reminder content as Body Emphasis.
Timer may render as Close Gauge or this rectangular template.
If Timer renders as rectangular, it must use this template.
Preserve reset, start/pause, and cancel control slots.
Checklist must use this full-face template.
Checklist must be the only widget on the watch face.

Checklist must preserve the locked Figma component geometry: widget x=0 y=0 width=205 height=251; date x=16 y=16 width=70 height=22; time x=139 y=16 width=50 height=22 right-aligned SF Compact Regular 19pt; title x=16 y=42; list x=6 y=71 width=193.
The generator may fill only title, items, and checked/completed state; it must not invent a separate watch-face time/date layout around checklist.
Render checklist items as rows with radio buttons on the left and Body text on the right.
